CoherentTwoGap.lean:
import D1Bound5.CoherentTwoUpper
import D1Bound5.CoherentTwoSize

open Finset
open scoped NumberField
open Module

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The quotient-weighted two-anchor form is exactly the difference
of its two actual coherent anchor roots and its terminal-root term. -/
theorem coherentQuotientForm_two_eq
    (a : Fin 2 → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (p q eta : ℂ) :
    coherentQuotientForm a (a 0 - a 1) p q eta =
      coherentAnchorRoot (a 0) p q eta - coherentAnchorRoot (a 1) p q eta -
        (a 0 - a 1) * coherentTerminalRoot p q eta := by
  have hw (i : Fin 2) :
      (a 0 - a 1) * a i ^ (2 - 2) /
          (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (a i - a j)) = coherentWeights2 a i := by
    exact (coherentWeights2_eq_quotient a hinj i).symm
  unfold coherentQuotientForm
  simp_rw [hw]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, coherentWeights2]
  ring

/-- The quantitative two-anchor gap after the analytic upper bound
and integral lower bound have been supplied.  The root-size inputs are
only the elementary consequences of `z^2=pq+1`. -/
theorem coherent_two_strong_gap_scalar
    (A B P Q Z : ℝ) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 3 ≤ B) (hP : 5 * B ≤ P)
    (hAP : 32 ≤ A * P) (hQ : 5 * A * B * P ≤ Q)
    (hPQ : 10000 < P * Q) (hZ : 0 ≤ Z)
    (hZlower : P * Q - 1 ≤ Z ^ 2) (hZupper : Z ^ 2 ≤ P * Q + 1)
    (hbound : 1 < 21 * B / (20 * Z) + Z / (2 * A * P ^ 2)) :
    A ^ 2 * P ^ 3 < (10001 / 10000 : ℝ) * Q := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hP0 : 0 < P := by linarith
  have hAP0 : 0 < A * P := by positivity
  have hBP : B ^ 2 ≤ B * P := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show B ≤ P by linarith) hB0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hPQlower : 5 * (A * P) * B ^ 2 ≤ P * Q := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBP (by positivity : 0 ≤ 5 * (A * P))
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ hP0.le
    nlinarith only [h1, h2]
  have h160 : 160 * B ^ 2 ≤ 5 * (A * P) * B ^ 2 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAP (by positivity : 0 ≤ 5 * B ^ 2)
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hBsq : 9 ≤ B ^ 2 := by nlinarith only [hB, sq_nonneg (B-3)]
  have hZsq : (3 * B) ^ 2 < Z ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith only [hZlower, hPQlower, h160, hBsq]
  have hZ3 : 3 * B < Z := (sq_lt_sq₀ (by positivity) hZ).mp hZsq
  have hZ0 : 0 < Z := by linarith
  have hfirst : 21 * B / (20 * Z) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).2
    nlinarith only [hZ3, hB0]
  have hsecond : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < Z / (2 * A * P ^ 2) := by
    linarith only [hbound, hfirst]
  have hZgap : A * P ^ 2 < Z := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * A * P ^ 2)).mp hsecond
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hsquare : (A * P ^ 2) ^ 2 < Z ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (by positivity) hZ).mpr hZgap
  have hPQupper : P * Q + 1 < (10001 / 10000 : ℝ) * (P * Q) := by
    nlinarith only [hPQ]
  apply (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hP0).mp
  nlinarith only [hsquare, hZupper, hPQupper]

/-- The strong two-anchor gap for genuine entries of the full ring of
integers.  Nonvanishing, coefficient integrality, coherent branch bounds,
the complete homogeneous tail, and the integral modulus lower bound
are all discharged by the proved preceding results. -/
theorem full_ring_coherent_two_strong_gap
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {T : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hT : IsD1 T) {a b p q : 𝓞 K}
    (ha : a ∈ T) (hb : b ∈ T) (hp : p ∈ T) (hq : q ∈ T)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hap : a ≠ p) (haq : a ≠ q)
    (hbp : b ≠ p) (hbq : b ≠ q) (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (eta : ℂ) (heta : eta ^ 2 = phi (p : K) * phi (q : K))
    (hAB : ‖phi (a : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (b : K)‖)
    (hB : 3 ≤ ‖phi (b : K)‖) (hP : 5 * ‖phi (b : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (p : K)‖)
    (hAP : 32 ≤ ‖phi (a : K)‖ * ‖phi (p : K)‖)
    (hQ : 5 * ‖phi (a : K)‖ * ‖phi (b : K)‖ * ‖phi (p : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (q : K)‖)
    (hPQ : 10000 < ‖phi (p : K)‖ * ‖phi (q : K)‖) :
    ‖phi (a : K)‖ ^ 2 * ‖phi (p : K)‖ ^ 3 <
      (10001 / 10000 : ℝ) * ‖phi (q : K)‖ := by
  let f : 𝓞 K →+* ℂ := phi.comp (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)
  let av : Fin 2 → ℂ := ![f a, f b]
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    exact phi.injective hxy
  have hinj : Function.Injective av := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (hab (hf hij))
    · exact False.elim (hab (hf hij.symm))
    · rfl
  have hA : 1 ≤ ‖f a‖ := one_le_norm_integer hK phi (hT.1 a ha)
  have hA0 : 0 < ‖f a‖ := by linarith
  have hP0 : 0 < ‖f p‖ := by change 0 < ‖phi (p : K)‖; nlinarith only [hB, hP]
  have hQ0 : 0 < ‖f q‖ := by
    have h := one_le_norm_integer hK phi (hT.1 q hq)
    change 0 < ‖phi (q : K)‖
    linarith
  have hQ4 : 4 * ‖f p‖ ≤ ‖f q‖ := by
    have hAB3 : 3 ≤ ‖f a‖ * ‖f b‖ := by
      have h := mul_le_mul hA hB (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3) hA0.le
      nlinarith only [h]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAB3 hP0.le
    change 4 * ‖phi (p : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (q : K)‖
    nlinarith only [h, hQ, hP0]
  have hlow := (full_ring_coherent_two_nonzero_and_one_le_norm hK phi hT
    a b p q ha hb hp hq hab hap haq hbp hbq hpq eta heta hB hP hQ).2
  have hupp := coherent_two_norm_lt av (f p) (f q) eta hinj hA0 hP0 hAB
    hAP hQ4 hPQ heta
  rw [coherentQuotientForm_two_eq av hinj] at hupp
  have hbound : 1 < 21 * ‖f b‖ / (20 * ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta‖) +
      ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta‖ / (2 * ‖f a‖ * ‖f p‖ ^ 2) := by
    exact hlow.trans_lt hupp
  have hzsq : (coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta) ^ 2 = f p * f q + 1 :=
    coherent_analytic_terminal_root_sq (f p) (f q) eta
      (norm_pos_iff.mp hP0) (norm_pos_iff.mp hQ0) heta
  have hnorm : ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta‖ ^ 2 = ‖f p * f q + 1‖ := by
    simpa only [norm_pow] using congrArg norm hzsq
  have hZupper : ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖f p‖ * ‖f q‖ + 1 := by
    rw [hnorm]
    simpa only [norm_mul, norm_one] using norm_add_le (f p * f q) (1 : ℂ)
  have hZlower : ‖f p‖ * ‖f q‖ - 1 ≤ ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h := norm_sub_le (f p * f q + 1) (1 : ℂ)
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, norm_mul, norm_one, ← hnorm] at h
    linarith
  exact coherent_two_strong_gap_scalar ‖f a‖ ‖f b‖ ‖f p‖ ‖f q‖
    ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f p) (f q) eta‖ hA hB hP hAP hQ hPQ
    (norm_nonneg _) hZlower hZupper hbound

end D1Bound5
CoherentThreeNonvanishing.lean:
import D1Bound5.CoherentThreeSimultaneous

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Elementary symmetric norm bounds for four ordered anchors. -/
theorem coherent_elementary_norm_bounds
    (a : Fin 4 → ℂ)
    (h01 : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖) (h12 : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖) (h23 : ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖a 3‖) :
    ‖coherentElementary2 a‖ ≤ 6 * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ ∧
    ‖coherentElementary3 a‖ ≤ 4 * ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ ∧
    ‖coherentElementary4 a‖ = ‖a 0‖ * ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := by
  let v2 : Fin 6 → ℂ := ![a 0*a 1, a 0*a 2, a 0*a 3,
    a 1*a 2, a 1*a 3, a 2*a 3]
  let v3 : Fin 4 → ℂ := ![a 0*a 1*a 2, a 0*a 1*a 3,
    a 0*a 2*a 3, a 1*a 2*a 3]
  have he2 : coherentElementary2 a = ∑ i, v2 i := by
    simp [coherentElementary2, v2, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring
  have he3 : coherentElementary3 a = ∑ i, v3 i := by
    simp [coherentElementary3, v3, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring
  have hv2 (i : Fin 6) : ‖v2 i‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp only [v2, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ, norm_mul]
    all_goals gcongr <;> linarith
  have hv3 (i : Fin 4) : ‖v3 i‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp only [v3, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ, norm_mul]
    all_goals gcongr <;> linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he2]
    calc
      ‖∑ i, v2 i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖v2 i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 6, ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hv2 i)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  · rw [he3]
    calc
      ‖∑ i, v3 i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖v3 i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 4, ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hv3 i)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  · simp [coherentElementary4, norm_mul]

/-- The rational identity forced by simultaneous vanishing gives the
manuscript's sharp enough upper bound for `|pq+1|`. -/
theorem coherent_four_vanishing_identity_norm_le
    (e2 e3 e4 p q : ℂ) (A B S T : ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBS : B ≤ S) (hST : S ≤ T)
    (he2 : ‖e2‖ ≤ 6*S*T) (he3 : ‖e3‖ ≤ 4*B*S*T)
    (he4 : ‖e4‖ = A*B*S*T)
    (hid : p*q+1 = (e2+1-e3^2/(4*e4))^2/(4*e4)) :
    ‖p*q+1‖ ≤ 121*B*S*T/(4*A^3) := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := hA0.trans_le hAB
  have hS0 : 0 < S := hB0.trans_le hBS
  have hT0 : 0 < T := hS0.trans_le hST
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ S := hA.trans (hAB.trans hBS)
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := hS1.trans hST
  have hST1 : 1 ≤ S*T := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hS1 hT1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hS0.le
    simpa using h
  have hABST : A ≤ B*S*T := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hST1 hB0.le
    nlinarith only [h, hAB]
  have hAST : A*S*T ≤ B*S*T := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAB (by positivity : 0 ≤ S*T)
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hden : ‖(4 : ℂ)*e4‖ = 4*(A*B*S*T) := by
    rw [norm_mul, he4]
    norm_num
  have hE3sq : ‖e3‖^2 ≤ (4*B*S*T)^2 := by gcongr
  have hterm : ‖e3^2/((4 : ℂ)*e4)‖ ≤ 4*B*S*T/A := by
    rw [norm_div, norm_pow, hden]
    calc
      ‖e3‖^2 / (4*(A*B*S*T)) ≤ (4*B*S*T)^2 / (4*(A*B*S*T)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE3sq (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by field_simp; ring
  have hinner : ‖e2+1-e3^2/(4*e4)‖ ≤ 6*S*T+1+4*B*S*T/A := by
    have h := norm_sub_le (e2+1) (e3^2/(4*e4))
    have h' := norm_add_le e2 (1 : ℂ)
    rw [norm_one] at h'
    linarith only [h, h', he2, hterm]
  have hcoarse : 6*S*T+1+4*B*S*T/A ≤ 11*B*S*T/A := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hA0).mp
    have heq1 : (6*S*T+1+4*B*S*T/A)*A = 6*A*S*T+A+4*B*S*T := by field_simp; ring
    have heq2 : (11*B*S*T/A)*A = 11*B*S*T := by field_simp; ring
    rw [heq1, heq2]
    nlinarith only [hABST, hAST]
  have hinner2 : ‖e2+1-e3^2/(4*e4)‖^2 ≤ (11*B*S*T/A)^2 := by
    have h := hinner.trans hcoarse
    gcongr
  rw [hid, norm_div, norm_pow, hden]
  calc
    _ ≤ (11*B*S*T/A)^2 / (4*(A*B*S*T)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hinner2 (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by field_simp; ring

/-- The ordered modulus hypothesis makes the upper bound from
simultaneous vanishing incompatible with the elementary reverse
triangle inequality. -/
theorem coherent_four_vanishing_size_contradiction
    (A B S T P Q Z : ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBS : B ≤ S) (hST : S ≤ T)
    (hTP : T ≤ P) (hPQ : P ≤ Q)
    (hsize : 32*B*S*T/A^3 ≤ P^2)
    (hupper : Z ≤ 121*B*S*T/(4*A^3)) (hlower : P*Q-1 ≤ Z) : False := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := hA0.trans_le hAB
  have hS0 : 0 < S := hB0.trans_le hBS
  have hT0 : 0 < T := hS0.trans_le hST
  have hP0 : 0 < P := hT0.trans_le hTP
  have hr : 1 ≤ B*S*T/A^3 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < A^3)).2
    have h1 := mul_le_mul hAB (hAB.trans hBS) hA0.le hB0.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul h1 (hAB.trans (hBS.trans hST)) hA0.le (by positivity : 0 ≤ B*S)
    nlinarith only [h2]
  have hp2 : P^2 ≤ P*Q := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPQ hP0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hs : 32*(B*S*T/A^3) ≤ P^2 := by
    calc
      _ = 32*B*S*T/A^3 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := hsize
  have hu : Z ≤ (121/4 : ℝ)*(B*S*T/A^3) := by
    calc
      Z ≤ 121*B*S*T/(4*A^3) := hupper
      _ = _ := by ring
  nlinarith only [hr, hp2, hs, hu, hlower]

/-- The two coherent polynomial-weight forms cannot both vanish under
the four-anchor size condition.  Arbitrary square-root signs are
allowed, provided the two forms use the same roots on their overlap. -/
theorem coherent_two_three_forms_not_both_zero
    (a R : Fin 4 → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (p q z : ℂ)
    (hz : z^2 = p*q+1) (hR : ∀ i, (R i)^2 = (a i*p+1)*(a i*q+1))
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a 0‖) (hAB : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖)
    (hBS : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖) (hST : ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖a 3‖)
    (hTP : ‖a 3‖ ≤ ‖p‖) (hPQ : ‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖)
    (hsize : 32*‖a 1‖*‖a 2‖*‖a 3‖/‖a 0‖^3 ≤ ‖p‖^2) :
    (-(a 0-a 1)*(a 0-a 2)*(a 1-a 2)*z +
      a 0*(a 1-a 2)*R 0 - a 1*(a 0-a 2)*R 1 + a 2*(a 0-a 1)*R 2 ≠ 0) ∨
    (-(a 0-a 1)*(a 0-a 3)*(a 1-a 3)*z +
      a 0*(a 1-a 3)*R 0 - a 1*(a 0-a 3)*R 1 + a 3*(a 0-a 1)*R 3 ≠ 0) := by
  by_contra hzero
  push_neg at hzero
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    apply norm_pos_iff.mp
    fin_cases i <;> linarith
  have hid := coherent_two_three_forms_vanishing_identity a R hinj ha p q z hz hR hzero.1 hzero.2
  obtain ⟨he2, he3, he4⟩ := coherent_elementary_norm_bounds a hAB hBS hST
  have hupper := coherent_four_vanishing_identity_norm_le
    (coherentElementary2 a) (coherentElementary3 a) (coherentElementary4 a) p q
    ‖a 0‖ ‖a 1‖ ‖a 2‖ ‖a 3‖ hA hAB hBS hST he2 he3 he4 hid
  have hlower : ‖p‖*‖q‖-1 ≤ ‖p*q+1‖ := by
    have h := norm_sub_le (p*q+1) (1 : ℂ)
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, norm_mul, norm_one] at h
    linarith
  exact coherent_four_vanishing_size_contradiction
    ‖a 0‖ ‖a 1‖ ‖a 2‖ ‖a 3‖ ‖p‖ ‖q‖ ‖p*q+1‖
    hA hAB hBS hST hTP hPQ hsize hupper hlower

def coherentTriple012 {F : Type*} (a : Fin 4 → F) : Fin 3 → F :=
  fun i => a (![0,1,2] i)

def coherentTriple013 {F : Type*} (a : Fin 4 → F) : Fin 3 → F :=
  fun i => a (![0,1,3] i)

/-- Simultaneous nonvanishing for the actual two coherent quotient
forms.  The chosen analytic roots supply all square identities; the
remaining hypotheses are precisely distinctness, ordering and size. -/
theorem coherent_three_quotient_forms_not_both_zero
    (a : Fin 4 → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (p q eta : ℂ)
    (heta : eta^2 = p*q)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a 0‖) (hAB : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖)
    (hBS : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖) (hST : ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖a 3‖)
    (hTP : ‖a 3‖ ≤ ‖p‖) (hPQ : ‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖)
    (hsize : 32*‖a 1‖*‖a 2‖*‖a 3‖/‖a 0‖^3 ≤ ‖p‖^2) :
    coherentQuotientForm (coherentTriple012 a)
      (coherentVandermonde3 (coherentTriple012 a)) p q eta ≠ 0 ∨
    coherentQuotientForm (coherentTriple013 a)
      (coherentVandermonde3 (coherentTriple013 a)) p q eta ≠ 0 := by
  have hinj2 : Function.Injective (coherentTriple012 a) :=
    hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,2] : Fin 3 → Fin 4))
  have hinj3 : Function.Injective (coherentTriple013 a) :=
    hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,3] : Fin 3 → Fin 4))
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    apply norm_pos_iff.mp
    fin_cases i <;> linarith
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith : 0 < ‖p‖)
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith : 0 < ‖q‖)
  let z := coherentTerminalRoot p q eta
  let R : Fin 4 → ℂ := fun i => coherentAnchorRoot (a i) p q eta
  have hz : z^2 = p*q+1 := coherent_analytic_terminal_root_sq p q eta hp hq heta
  have hR : ∀ i, (R i)^2 = (a i*p+1)*(a i*q+1) := fun i =>
    coherent_analytic_anchor_root_sq (a i) p q eta (ha i) hp hq heta
  have h := coherent_two_three_forms_not_both_zero a R hinj p q z hz hR
    hA hAB hBS hST hTP hPQ hsize
  rw [coherentQuotientForm_three_eq _ hinj2, coherentQuotientForm_three_eq _ hinj3]
  simpa [coherentTriple012, coherentTriple013, R, z] using h

end D1Bound5
CoherentParameterForms.lean:
import D1Bound5.CoherentThreeParameters

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Exact-form norm control before inserting a numerical remainder
estimate.  This interface is shared by the parameter and four-anchor
lemmas. -/
theorem coherentQuotientForm_norm_le_remainder
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℂ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective a)
    (Delta p q eta : ℂ) (hDelta : Delta ≠ 0) (heta : eta ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ i, ‖p⁻¹*(a i)⁻¹‖ < 1) (hq : ∀ i, ‖q⁻¹*(a i)⁻¹‖ < 1) :
    ‖coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta‖ ≤ ‖Delta‖*‖eta‖*
      (‖1-(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ)‖ + ‖coherentRemainder a p q‖/(∏ i, ‖a i‖)) := by
  let c : ℂ := (-1)^ (m-1) * (∏ i, a i)⁻¹
  have hexact := coherentQuotientForm_normalized_eq a hm ha hinj Delta p q eta hDelta heta hp hq
  have hmul : coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta = (Delta*eta)*
      (1-(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ)+c*coherentRemainder a p q) := by
    have h := (div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hDelta heta)).mp hexact
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  have hc : ‖c‖ = (∏ i, ‖a i‖)⁻¹ := by
    simp [c, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, norm_prod]
  rw [hmul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity : 0 ≤ ‖Delta‖*‖eta‖)
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖1-(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ)‖ + ‖c*coherentRemainder a p q‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [norm_mul, hc]; ring

/-- A zero coherent form equates the exact remainder modulus to the
near-one defect modulus.  No asymptotic estimate is assumed. -/
theorem coherentQuotientForm_zero_norm_relation
    {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℂ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective a)
    (Delta p q eta : ℂ) (hDelta : Delta ≠ 0) (heta : eta ≠ 0)
    (hp : ∀ i, ‖p⁻¹*(a i)⁻¹‖ < 1) (hq : ∀ i, ‖q⁻¹*(a i)⁻¹‖ < 1)
    (hL : coherentQuotientForm a Delta p q eta = 0) :
    ‖1-(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ)‖ = ‖coherentRemainder a p q‖/(∏ i, ‖a i‖) := by
  let c : ℂ := (-1)^(m-1)*(∏ i, a i)⁻¹
  have h := coherentQuotientForm_normalized_eq a hm ha hinj Delta p q eta hDelta heta hp hq
  rw [hL, zero_div] at h
  have heq : 1-(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ) = -c*coherentRemainder a p q := by
    linear_combination -h
  rw [heq, norm_mul, norm_neg]
  have hc : ‖c‖ = (∏ i, ‖a i‖)⁻¹ := by
    simp [c, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, norm_prod]
  rw [hc]
  ring

/-- Exact scalar vanishing window in terms of two proved remainder
constants.  The manuscript's rows are obtained by rational comparison. -/
theorem coherent_three_window_scalar
    (V P Q d F ell u : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V) (hP : 0 < P) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hdlo : 100/(201*P*Q) < d) (hdhi : d < 100/(199*P*Q))
    (hFlo : ell/P^3 ≤ F) (hFhi : F ≤ u/P^3) (hrel : d = F/V) :
    100*V*P^2/(201*u) < Q ∧ Q < 100*V*P^2/(199*ell) := by
  have hlo : 100/(201*P*Q) < u/(V*P^3) := by
    calc
      _ < d := hdlo
      _ = F/V := hrel
      _ ≤ (u/P^3)/V := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hFhi hV.le
      _ = _ := by field_simp; ring
  have hhi : ell/(V*P^3) < 100/(199*P*Q) := by
    calc
      _ = (ell/P^3)/V := by field_simp; ring
      _ ≤ F/V := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hFlo hV.le
      _ = d := hrel.symm
      _ < _ := hdhi
  constructor
  · apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 201*u)).2
    have h := (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp hlo
    apply (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hP).mp
    nlinarith only [h]
  · apply (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 199*ell)).2
    have h := (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp hhi
    apply (mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right hP).mp
    nlinarith only [h]

/-- Direct parameter estimate from the exact coherent norm identity. -/
theorem coherent_three_parameter_upper_scalar
    (V P Q E Z D d F L u lam : ℝ)
    (hV : 0 < V) (hP : 0 < P) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hE : 0 < E)
    (hZ : 0 < Z) (hD : 0 < D) (hu : 0 < u)
    (hEsq : E^2 = P*Q)
    (hZlo : (99/100 : ℝ)*E < Z) (hZhi : Z < (101/100 : ℝ)*E)
    (hd : d < 100/(199*P*Q)) (hF : F ≤ u/P^3)
    (hlam : 100*u/99 < lam) (hL : L ≤ D*E*(d+F/V)) :
    L < 51*D/(100*Z) + lam*D*Z/(V*P^3) := by
  have hfirst : D*E*d < 51*D/(100*Z) := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd (mul_pos hD hE)
    have heq : D*E*(100/(199*P*Q)) = 100*D/(199*E) := by
      rw [← hEsq]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h2 : 100*D/(199*E) < 51*D/(100*Z) := by
      apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hZhi (by positivity : 0 < 10000*D)
      nlinarith only [h, mul_pos hD hE]
    exact (h1.trans_eq heq).trans h2
  have hsecond : D*E*(F/V) < lam*D*Z/(V*P^3) := by
    have h1 : D*E*(F/V) ≤ D*u*E/(V*P^3) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ D*E*((u/P^3)/V) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hF hV.le) (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by field_simp; ring
    have huE : u*E < lam*Z := by
      have he : E < (100/99 : ℝ)*Z := by linarith only [hZlo]
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left he hu
      have h3 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hlam hZ
      nlinarith only [h2, h3]
    have h2 : D*u*E/(V*P^3) < lam*D*Z/(V*P^3) := by
      apply div_lt_div_of_pos_right _ (by positivity)
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left huE hD
      nlinarith only [h]
    exact h1.trans_lt h2
  have hcoarse : L ≤ D*E*d+D*E*(F/V) := by nlinarith only [hL]
  exact hcoarse.trans_lt (add_lt_add hfirst hsecond)

/-- The complete three-anchor interpolation-parameter lemma for the
actual coherent form.  Exact numerical row checks are separate from
the analytic proof; all remainder and branch hypotheses are discharged. -/
theorem coherent_three_parameter_form_bounds
    (a : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (p q eta : ℂ)
    (A H lam U : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (ha : ∀ i, A ≤ ‖a i‖)
    (hP : 0 < ‖p‖) (hQ : 4*‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖) (hPQ : 10000 < ‖p‖*‖q‖)
    (hH : 1 < H) (hAP : H ≤ A*‖p‖) (heta : eta^2 = p*q)
    (hell : 0 < coherentThreeLowerConstant H) (hu : 0 < coherentThreeUpperConstant H)
    (hlam : 100*coherentThreeUpperConstant H/99 < lam)
    (hwindowLow : 5 < 100/(201*coherentThreeUpperConstant H))
    (hwindowHigh : 100/(199*coherentThreeLowerConstant H) < U) :
    ‖coherentQuotientForm a (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta‖ <
        51*‖coherentVandermonde3 a‖/(100*‖coherentTerminalRoot p q eta‖) +
          lam*‖coherentVandermonde3 a‖*‖coherentTerminalRoot p q eta‖ /
            ((∏ i, ‖a i‖)*‖p‖^3) ∧
      (coherentQuotientForm a (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta = 0 →
        5*(∏ i, ‖a i‖)*‖p‖^2 < ‖q‖ ∧
          ‖q‖ < U*(∏ i, ‖a i‖)*‖p‖^2) := by
  let P := ‖p‖
  let Q := ‖q‖
  let V := ∏ i, ‖a i‖
  let E := ‖eta‖
  let Z := ‖coherentTerminalRoot p q eta‖
  let D := ‖coherentVandermonde3 a‖
  let d := ‖1-(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ)‖
  let F := ‖coherentRemainder a p q‖
  have han : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := fun i => norm_pos_iff.mp (hA.trans_le (ha i))
  have hV : 0 < V := Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hA.trans_le (ha i))
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by change 0 < ‖q‖; nlinarith only [hP,hQ]
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hP
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hQ0
  have heta0 : eta ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] at heta
    exact (mul_ne_zero hp0 hq0) heta.symm
  have hE : 0 < E := norm_pos_iff.mpr heta0
  have hEsq : E^2 = P*Q := by
    simpa only [E,P,Q,norm_pow,norm_mul] using congrArg norm heta
  have hDelta : coherentVandermonde3 a ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hinj.ne (by decide)))
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hinj.ne (by decide))))
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hinj.ne (by decide)))
  have hD : 0 < D := norm_pos_iff.mpr hDelta
  have hW : ‖p⁻¹*q⁻¹‖ = 1/(P*Q) := by
    simp [P,Q,norm_mul,norm_inv,one_div,mul_inv_rev,mul_comm]
  have hWsmall : ‖p⁻¹*q⁻¹‖ < (1/10000 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hW]
    exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by norm_num) hPQ
  have hnear := coherent_cpow_half_near_one (p⁻¹*q⁻¹)
    (mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hp0) (inv_ne_zero hq0)) hWsmall
  have hZeq : Z = E*‖(1+p⁻¹*q⁻¹)^(1/2 : ℂ)‖ := by
    simp only [Z,E,coherentTerminalRoot,norm_mul]
  have hZlo : (99/100 : ℝ)*E < Z := by
    rw [hZeq]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hnear.1 hE
  have hZhi : Z < (101/100 : ℝ)*E := by
    rw [hZeq]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hnear.2.1 hE
  have hZ : 0 < Z := by nlinarith only [hZlo,hE]
  have hdlo : 100/(201*P*Q) < d := by
    have h := hnear.2.2.1
    rw [hW] at h
    calc
      _ = (100/201 : ℝ)*(1/(P*Q)) := by ring
      _ < _ := h
  have hdhi : d < 100/(199*P*Q) := by
    have h := hnear.2.2.2
    rw [hW] at h
    calc
      _ < (100/199 : ℝ)*(1/(P*Q)) := h
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hp : ‖p⁻¹‖ = 1/P := by simp [P,norm_inv,one_div]
  have hq : ‖q⁻¹‖ ≤ 1/(4*P) := by
    simpa only [Q,norm_inv,one_div] using
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity : 0 < 4*P) hQ
  have hq' : ‖q⁻¹‖ ≤ 1/P := hq.trans
    (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hP (by change ‖p‖ ≤ 4*‖p‖; nlinarith only [hP]))
  have hxp : ∀ i, ‖p⁻¹*(a i)⁻¹‖ < 1 := by
    intro i
    exact coherent_half_binomial_manuscript_anchor_radius Finset.univ a p⁻¹ A P
      hA hP (fun j _ => ha j) hp.le (hH.trans_le hAP) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hxq : ∀ i, ‖q⁻¹*(a i)⁻¹‖ < 1 := by
    intro i
    exact coherent_half_binomial_manuscript_anchor_radius Finset.univ a q⁻¹ A P
      hA hP (fun j _ => ha j) hq' (hH.trans_le hAP) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  obtain ⟨hFlo,hFhi⟩ := coherentRemainder_three_parameter_norm_bounds
    a p q A P H hA hP ha hp hq hH hAP
  have hL := coherentQuotientForm_norm_le_remainder a (by decide) han hinj
    (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta hDelta heta0 hxp hxq
  constructor
  · exact coherent_three_parameter_upper_scalar V P Q E Z D d F
      ‖coherentQuotientForm a (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta‖
      (coherentThreeUpperConstant H) lam hV hP hQ0 hE hZ hD hu
      hEsq hZlo hZhi hdhi hFhi hlam hL
  · intro hzero
    have hrel := coherentQuotientForm_zero_norm_relation a (by decide) han hinj
      (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta hDelta heta0 hxp hxq hzero
    have hw := coherent_three_window_scalar V P Q d F
      (coherentThreeLowerConstant H) (coherentThreeUpperConstant H)
      hV hP hQ0 hell hu hdlo hdhi hFlo hFhi hrel
    constructor
    · calc
        5*V*P^2 < (100/(201*coherentThreeUpperConstant H))*V*P^2 := by
          have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hwindowLow (by positivity : 0 < V*P^2)
          nlinarith only [h]
        _ = 100*V*P^2/(201*coherentThreeUpperConstant H) := by ring
        _ < Q := hw.1
    · calc
        Q < 100*V*P^2/(199*coherentThreeLowerConstant H) := hw.2
        _ = (100/(199*coherentThreeLowerConstant H))*V*P^2 := by ring
        _ < U*V*P^2 := by
          have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hwindowHigh (by positivity : 0 < V*P^2)
          nlinarith only [h]

end D1Bound5
